n: I Love Algorithms card deck (Stanford d.school)
t: A printable card kit for prototyping machine learning ideas without screens.
steps: Find the I Love Algorithms kit on the Stanford d.school site.
Open the linked Google Drive folder.
Choose the K-12 version for classroom use.
Print the Algorithms Card Deck, the Dataset Card Deck, and the Game Board.
Cut the cards and sort them into sets.
Check that Google Drive is open on the school network.
